correctness.rationale: Separated-variable Jacobian quotient A_(F_r)=A_h^⊗r has dimension μ^r; multiplication by F_r is the diagonal Kronecker sum N_r of nilpotent Milnor multiplication N. Embedding each nilpotent Jordan block into an sl2 irreducible realizes N_r as diagonal raising operator. The weight character is P_h(z)^r; for irreducible highest weight j, multiplicity c_j-c_(j+2), and telescoping by parity gives dim ker N_r=c_0+c_1. Hence τ(F_r)=[z^0]P^r+[z^1]P^r exactly for r>=1. The symmetric finitely supported weight law has variance ∑ℓ(ℓ²-1)/(3μ). When N!=0 the lattice span is 1 if mixed parity or 2 if pure parity; exactly two adjacent sites together yield sqrt(2/(π σ² r)) with a relative O_h(1/r) via symmetric Fourier expansion and exponential suppression away from maximal-modulus points. N=0 gives ratio one. I independently compared Kronecker matrix kernels to character coefficient dimensions in nine exact small cases.
residual_risks: Fixed isolated complex analytic singularity, no uniformity across varying germs or positive characteristic.
Independent rank checks are finite and do not establish the local central limit law.
